newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices rise further on higher demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices rise further on higher demand.

text.p: Sugar prices rose futher on Tuesday on higher demand from individual and bulk consumers, dealers said.
"Wedding season demand from individuals, coupled with bulk demand from soft drink makers are pushing up prices," said a dealer.

In Ready, S-30 sugar rose 10/15 rupees to 1,360/1,410 rupees per quintal and M-30 was higher by 9.0/10 rupees at 1,401/1,475. On Monday prices of S-30 rose by 10 rupees and M-30 by five rupees per quintal.
"Market sentiment turned strong in anticipation of a rise in demand in the coming days," said a trader.
